battle.name: 芬蘭內戰
battle.theater: 芬蘭灣與赫爾辛基海岸線
battle.brief: 1918年1月27日至5月15日，芬蘭白衛軍在曼納海姆率領下對抗紅衛軍與俄國紅軍支援，坦佩雷巷戰最為慘烈。鐵甲艦雖已退場，1913年入列的維斯特曼蘭級裝甲艦維納莫寧與伊爾馬寧仍是世上最後一批鐵甲式裝甲艦，3月在芬蘭灣巡弋、封鎖並轟擊紅方海岸據點，牽制俄國波羅的海艦隊。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰的兩大陣線是白軍與紅軍。白軍以芬蘭議會與白衛軍最高司令部為骨幹，總司令曼納海姆元帥在戰線上統合芬蘭白衛軍各師、德國波羅的海海軍師（埃爾哈特海軍旅）約一萬四千名帝國德軍、瑞典志願兵旅約一千人，以及愛沙尼亞、波蘭與俄國白軍志願者。紅軍由紅衛軍總部與各戰區委員會指揮，兵力約八萬至九萬人，其中含二千六百名女性紅衛軍，另有前俄羅斯帝國陸軍四至五千人成建制參戰，並得到蘇俄提供軍火、經費與軍事顧問；彼得格勒革命軍事委員會派員直接介入紅軍的最高指揮。內戰期間芬蘭社會主義工人共和國在古奧皮奧宣告成立，由庫萊爾沃·曼納主持，與白軍議會在首都以外另立對立政權。海上的對峙屬同一場戰爭的另一條戰線：白軍只有自芬蘭海軍與德國分遣艦隊，紅軍則以俄羅斯波羅的海艦隊的制海權與重砲火力支援岸上作戰。
countriesEn: The two opposing lines were the Whites and the Reds. The White side was built around the Finnish Senate and the White Guard high command; Commander-in-Chief Mannerheim welded together on the front the Finnish White Guard divisions, roughly fourteen thousand Imperial German troops of the German Baltic Sea Division (Ehrhardt's Marinebrigade), about one thousand Swedish volunteers, and Estonian, Polish and Russian White volunteers. The Reds were directed by the Red Guard headquarters and its regional war committees, fielding some eighty to ninety thousand men including about 2,600 women in the Red Guard, with four to five thousand demobilised soldiers of the former Imperial Russian Army joining in formed units; Soviet Russia supplied arms, money and military advisers, and delegates of the Petrograd Soviet Military Administrative Commission took part directly in the Red high command. During the war the Finnish Socialist Workers' Republic was proclaimed at Kuopio and governed by Kullervo Manner, standing as a rival state to the White Senate everywhere outside the capital. The struggle at sea was another front of the same war: the Whites had only the Finnish navy and a German detachment of warships, while the Reds relied on the Russian Baltic Fleet for command of the sea and for heavy naval gunfire in support of the fighting ashore.
people: 白軍一方的關鍵人物是總司令曼納海姆元帥，他主張集中兵力、逐段殲滅，並在四月初以德軍海軍師為先鋒強攻坦佩雷；芬蘭議會領袖斯文胡富德出任國家元首，主持對外承認與新秩序。伊格納修斯將軍參與籌劃維堡方向的攻勢；德國方面由康拉德·沃爾夫中將、呂迪格·馮·格爾茨男爵、奧托·馮·布蘭登斯坦與胡戈·莫伊雷爾指揮波羅的海海軍師，漢斯·馮·齊爾施基與馮·伯根多夫則在赫爾辛基方向作戰。瑞典志願兵旅由哈拉爾·雅爾馬爾松與亞爾馬爾·弗里塞爾帶領。紅軍一方的最高指揮是庫萊爾沃·曼納，另有阿里·阿爾托寧、埃羅·阿帕萊寧、埃諾·拉希亞、埃韋爾特·埃洛蘭塔、奧古斯特·韋斯利、休戈·薩爾梅拉與海基·卡爾尤寧等地方指揮官；俄軍代表康斯坦丁·葉列梅耶夫、米哈伊爾·斯韋奇尼科夫與格奧爾基·布拉采爾在前線指揮蘇俄部隊。
peopleEn: Key figures on the White side were Commander-in-Chief Mannerheim, who insisted on concentrating force and destroying the enemy in turn and who used the German Baltic Sea Division as the spearhead of the assault on Tampere in early April, and Svinhufvud, leader of the Senate, who acted as head of state and handled foreign recognition of the new order. General Ignatius helped plan the offensive towards Vyborg; on the German side General Konrad Wolf, Rüdiger von der Goltz, Otto von Brandenstein and Hugo Meurer commanded the Baltic Sea Division, while Hans von Tschirschky and von Bögendorff led troops in the Helsinki sector. The Swedish volunteer brigade was under Harald Hjalmarson and Hjalmar Frisell. On the Red side the overall command belonged to Kullervo Manner, with local commanders such as Ali Aaltonen, Eero Haapalainen, Eino Rahja, Evert Eloranta, August Wesley, Hugo Salmela and Heikki Kaljunen; the Russian representatives Konstantin Eremeev, Mikhail Svechnikov and Georgy Bulatsel directed Soviet units on the front.
kits: 「鐵甲艦」這一型兵器到1918年基本退出演役序列：木殼包鐵的早期鐵甲艦，如英國1862年式的裝甲浮箱，在大戰初期就被無畏艦的火砲射程與航速淘汰。真正延續下來的是它的直系後裔——低乾舷、厚重裝甲帶、以大口徑主砲壓住射界的岸防裝甲艦。芬蘭海軍僅有的兩艘重裝甲戰艦就是維斯特曼蘭級的維納莫寧號與伊爾馬寧號：1901至1902年由瑞典芬布羅船廠建造，原為智利訂貨，後轉售俄國，1913年由俄國轉讓予芬蘭，1914年交付，排水量約二千三百噸，裝甲帶十公分，主砲為兩門十五公分與四門十公分，最大航速約二十節，編制百餘人。這兩艘船是1918年芬蘭海軍全部的重型兵力，也是當時世上仍帶鐵甲艦氣質的最後一批戰艦：它們無力與俄方戰列艦正面對抗，只能在近岸活動，執行封鎖、護航、輸送登陸部隊與轟擊島上砲台。陸上雙方的裝備同樣拼湊：白軍以德制七七野戰砲、毛瑟九八式步槍、馬克辛重機槍與手投炸彈為主，瑞典另運來一批步槍與野戰砲；紅軍則大量使用帝國時期留下的莫辛式步槍、七七七野戰砲與機槍，以及從俄國新運到的步槍。
kitsEn: The ironclad itself was by 1918 essentially out of service: wooden hulls sheathed in iron, of the British armoured floating battery type of 1862, had been swept from the fleets by the superior range and speed of the dreadnoughts. What actually survived was the direct descendant of that idea — the low freeboard coastal defence ship with a thick belt and heavy guns in broadside or end-on positions. The Finnish navy held only two armoured heavyweights, the Västmanland class Väinämöinen and Ilmarinen, built at the Finnbro shipyard in Sweden in 1901 and 1902, originally ordered by Chile, later resold to Russia and transferred by Russia to Finland in 1913 for delivery in 1914: about 2,300 tons displacement, a ten centimetre belt, two 15 cm and four 10 cm guns, about twenty knots and a complement of a little over a hundred. These two ships were the whole of the Finnish navy's heavy force and the last warships anywhere that still carried the ironclad character; they could not stand up to the Russian battle fleet in a line duel, so they stayed close to the Finnish shore to blockade, escort, land troops and shell island batteries. On land both sides armed themselves from leftovers: the Whites with German 7.7 cm field guns, Gewehr 98 rifles, Maxim machine guns and hand grenades, topped up by Swedish rifles and field guns; the Reds with large quantities of Imperial era Mosin rifles, 7.7 cm field guns and machine guns, plus fresh rifles shipped in from Russia.
tactics: 白軍的戰術以鐵路為主幹、以集中砲火配合縱隊突進為核心。德國教練的獵兵小組與德軍營連縱隊在正面突破口反覆衝擊，攻城時以工兵爆破配合手榴突擊逐屋推進。紅軍則以密集縱隊在城郊與街壘中死守，坦佩雷一役雙方在磚石街區內逐棟爭奪，白軍以重砲封鎖路口、逐點攻殲，紅軍靠夜間襲擊與冷槍消耗進攻方兵力。紅軍企圖奪取彼得格勒的攻勢在維堡關與拉克維雷被擋下。海上的戰術是封鎖與牽制：芬蘭裝甲艦在近岸巡弋，掩護北極航線船隊與登陸船隊，佈雷並用大口徑砲轟擊島嶼上的俄軍砲台；俄方則以巡洋艦與驅逐艦巡弋封鎖線，掩護沿岸砲台與紅軍的海上接觸。北方的冬季補給靠駿馬拖曳的雪橇、履帶車與人力縱隊完成，汽車與摩托化只出現在主要公路與鐵路沿線。
tacticsEn: White tactics rested on the railways and on concentrated fire followed by attack in column. German trained Jäger squads and German battalion columns made repeated frontal breaks, and in assaults engineers placed charges while grenadiers cleared barricades room by room. The Reds held dense columns in field fortifications and street barricades, and at Tampere the two sides fought house by house through the brick built-up quarters: the Whites sealed junctions with heavy guns and crushed point by point, while the Reds spent the attackers with night attacks and aimed fire. The Red drive on Petrograd was halted at the Vyborg Gate and at Rakvere. At sea the pattern was blockade and containment: the Finnish armoured ships cruised close inshore, covered the Arctic convoy route and the landing ships, laid mines and used their big guns against Russian island batteries; the Russians patrolled the blockade line with cruisers and destroyers and covered their shore guns and their contacts with the Reds. Winter supply in the north was carried by horse drawn sledges, tracked vehicles and human porters; motor transport appeared only along the main roads and railways.
data: 日期：1918年1月27日至5月15日。兵力：白軍約八萬至九萬白衛軍，另計獵兵一千四百五十人、德軍一萬四千人、瑞典志願兵約一千人；紅軍約八萬至九萬人（其中女性紅衛軍約二千六百人），另有前帝國俄軍四至五千人。傷亡：白軍陣亡約三千三百人、被槍決一千五百人、失蹤二十六人、俘虜死亡四人、意外死亡三十人；瑞典志願兵陣亡五十五人；德軍陣亡四百五十至五百人。紅軍陣亡約六千二百人、被槍決九千人、失蹤一千六百人、俘虜死亡一萬二千五百人（其中獲釋後急性死亡六百人）、意外死亡一百五十至二百人；俄軍陣亡八百至九百人、被槍決一千五百人。總傷亡約三萬二千至三萬三千人。坦佩雷之戰自4月1日打到5月6日，雙方傷亡合計逾兩萬人，是芬蘭史上傷亡最重的一役；赫爾辛基之戰在4月12日凌晨五時由二千至三千名德軍自西北方向發動。海軍方面，芬蘭可用的重裝甲兵力只有維斯特曼蘭級兩艦，排水量各約二千三百噸。
dataEn: Dates: 27 January to 15 May 1918. Strength: Whites about 80,000 to 90,000 White Guards, plus 1,450 Jägers, 14,000 Germans and about 1,000 Swedish volunteers; Reds about 80,000 to 90,000 men, of whom around 2,600 were women in the Red Guard, plus 4,000 to 5,000 former Imperial Russian soldiers. Casualties: on the White side about 3,300 killed, 1,500 executed, 26 missing, 4 deaths among prisoners and 30 accidental deaths; 55 Swedish volunteers killed; 450 to 500 Germans killed. On the Red side about 6,200 killed, 9,000 executed, 1,600 missing, 12,500 deaths among prisoners, of whom 600 died suddenly after release, and 150 to 200 accidental deaths; Russian troops lost 800 to 900 killed and 1,500 executed. Total casualties came to roughly 32,000 to 33,000. The battle of Tampere ran from 1 April to 6 May and cost both sides more than 20,000 casualties, the heaviest of any Finnish battle; the battle for Helsinki opened at 05:00 on 12 April with 2,000 to 3,000 German troops attacking from the north-west. At sea the Finnish armoured strength was the two Västmanland class ships, of about 2,300 tons displacement each.
cause: 導火線是一戰末期俄國的崩解。1917年芬蘭宣布獨立並成立議會，俄境內的革命政黨與白衛軍在同一塊土地上互相視為敵人，爭奪新國家的權力。蘇俄為維持彼得格勒的革命政權並牽制德國，主動武裝並資助紅軍，彼得格勒甚至直接向芬蘭境內的紅軍派送軍火與顧問；德國則希望藉白軍之手在波羅的海取得北岸的基地與港口，並向芬蘭輸入武裝與訓練，好讓芬蘭成為東線北方一枚可以移動的棋子。1917至1918年的歉收、糧價與物資管制，把城鄉的社會矛盾推到爆發邊界，勞工組織與白衛軍在各地互相動武，槍擊與縱火在城鎮與鄉村同時蔓延，最終在1918年1月底，全國多地幾乎同一天爆發全面武裝衝突。
causeEn: The spark was the collapse of Russia at the end of the First World War. In 1917 Finland declared independence and set up a parliament, and inside the former Russian Empire the revolutionary parties and the White Guard came to see each other as enemies competing over the new state. Soviet Russia armed and financed the Reds in order to hold Petrograd and to contain Germany, shipping arms and advisers from Petrograd itself to the Reds inside Finland; Germany, for its part, wanted the Whites to give it a foothold and ports on the northern shore of the Baltic, and poured in arms and training so that Finland would be a useful and movable piece on the Eastern Front. Poor harvests in 1917 and 1918, food prices and rationing pushed the social strains of town and country to the breaking point; workers' organisations and the White Guard were shooting at each other in many places, with gunfire and arson spreading through towns and villages alike, until in late January 1918 general armed conflict broke out almost on the same day in many parts of the country.
impact: 內戰之後白軍取得政權，紅衛軍主力被解散或被關押，數萬名俘虜分別收容於各地營地，部分在1919年前後經審訊、釋放或流亡俄國。芬蘭得以鞏固獨立，並在1918年11月建立空軍，早於多數歐洲國家，隨後經1919年的制憲會議、1920年轉為共和國並加入國際聯盟。芬蘭在東向與俄國邊境上的摩擦隨之而來：白軍於1918年6至7月攻取維堡，同年9至10月在索維河與卡累利阿東部作戰，戰役最終在俄國內戰的背景下收場。社會黨在芬蘭政治上遭到全面清洗，直到第二次大戰後才重新取得合法地位；而雙方互相指控的清算與槍決，成為芬蘭政治文化中最深的一道裂痕。
impactEn: After the war the Whites held the state, the main body of the Red Guard was dissolved or locked up, and tens of thousands of prisoners were held in camps across the country, some of them being tried, released or driven into exile in Russia before 1919. Finland consolidated its independence, founded its air force in November 1918 — earlier than most European countries — and then moved through the constituent assembly of 1919 to become a republic in 1920 and join the League of Nations. Friction with Russia over the eastern border followed: the Whites took Vyborg in June and July 1918, and fought on the Svir and in East Karelia in September and October, the campaign ending against the background of the Russian Civil War. The Socialists were wiped out of Finnish politics and only regained legal status after the Second World War, while the mutual accusations, purges and executions left the deepest scar in Finnish political culture.
result: 結果是白軍全勝。紅軍最高指揮於1918年2月底被白軍抓住並槍決，坦佩雷的紅軍政府在糧援斷絕、外援無望之下崩解，芬蘭社會主義工人共和國亦隨之瓦解；4月27日白軍議會與紅軍代表在古奧皮奧達成停戰協議，5月初坦佩雷的紅軍政府與守軍放下武器，北部與東部的殘餘武裝陸續被肅清，戰事於5月15日全面結束。芬蘭國家議會承認新政府並維持獨立，白軍中的德國指揮體系也隨戰事結束而解散，始終未能建立德國所期望的親德王朝；德國在芬蘭的影響力反而因為戰後的芬德糾紛與德國自身革命的爆發而一落千丈。紅軍殘部則渡入俄國，成為俄國內戰中的一支外來武裝，這條北翼戰線上的小小插曲，最後隨著白軍攻佔維堡與紅軍退向卡累利阿而收場。
resultEn: The result was a White victory. The Red high command was caught and shot by the Whites in late February 1918; the Red government in Tampere collapsed as its food ran out and no help arrived, and the Finnish Socialist Workers' Republic fell apart with it. On 27 April the White Senate and Red representatives signed an armistice at Kuopio; in early May the Red government and garrison of Tampere laid down their arms, and the last bands in the north and east were hunted down one by one, the war ending on 15 May. The Finnish parliament recognised the new government, independence was preserved, and the German command structure on the White side dissolved with the fighting, never establishing the German aligned monarchy Berlin had hoped for. German influence in Finland collapsed after the quarrel between the two countries and the German revolution itself. The surviving Red fighters crossed into Russia to become an armed contingent in the Russian Civil War, and this short-lived northern episode of that conflict finally closed with the White capture of Vyborg and the Red withdrawal towards Karelia.
